titleEnglish: Ya Husain Ya Husain — Traditional / Nusrat Fateh Ali Khan

verses.ar:
Ya Hussain! Ya Hussain!
Ya Hussain! Ya Hussain!
verses.en:
O Hussain! O Hussain!
O Hussain! O Hussain!

verses.ar:
Shaheed-e-Karbala ki mominoN jab yaad aati hai
Tadap jaati hai duniya, khoon ke aansooN bahaati hai
verses.en:
When believers remember the martyr of Karbala
The world trembles in anguish and weeps tears of blood

verses.ar:
Shah hast Hussain baadshah hast Hussain
Deen hast Hussain deen pana hast Hussain
Sar daad na daad dast dar dast-e-Yazeed
Haq aa ke bina La-Ila hast Hussain
verses.en:
Hussain is the king, Hussain is the sovereign
Hussain is the faith, Hussain is the guardian of faith
He gave his head but did not give his hand into the hand of Yazid
Hussain is the very foundation of La Ilaha (There is no god but God)

verses.ar:
Sajde mein sar kataane ko aakhir kata dia
Lekin Khuda ke naam ka danka baja dia
verses.en:
In the end his head was cut while in prostration
But he made the name of God resound throughout the world

verses.ar:
Dil se khudi ko bhool kar khud ko mita namaaz mein
Aayega tujh ko jab nazar roo-e-Khuda jab namaaz mein
Pahle Hussain ki tarah sar ko kata namaaz mein
verses.en:
Forget the self from your heart and erase yourself in prayer
You will behold the face of God when you are in prayer
First, like Hussain, give your head while in prayer

verses.ar:
Kis ki majaal ai Hussain tujh ko ho tujh se ham-saree
Baap ke ghar Imam the naana ke ghar payambari
Shakl-e-Hussain dekh kar haq bhi kahega hashr mein
Aey mere Mustafa ke laal ummat-e-Mustafa baree
verses.en:
Who has the power, O Hussain, to be your equal?
In his father's house he was Imam, in his grandfather's house he was raised among Prophets
Beholding the face of Hussain even the Truth will say on Judgement Day
O dear one of my Mustafa ﷺ — the nation of Mustafa is forgiven

verses.ar:
Salaami Karbala mein kya qayamat ki ghari hogi
Churi Shabbir ki gardan pe jis dam chal rahi hogi
Kaleja thaam kar Meer-e-falaq bhi rah gaya hoga
Kaleje per Ali Akbar ke barchi jab lagi hogi
verses.en:
What a moment of apocalypse that must have been in Karbala
When the blade was passing across the neck of Shabbir (Hussain)
Even the master of the heavens must have clutched his heart
When the spear struck the chest of Ali Akbar

verses.ar:
Mujhe jaane do paani bhar ke ye Abbas kehte the
Kayi din ki pyaasi hai Sakina ro rahi hogi
verses.en:
"Let me go and fetch the water" — so Abbas kept saying
For Sakina had been thirsty for days and was weeping

verses.ar:
Luti hai jaise duniya Karbala mein ibn-e-Haider ki
Kisi mazloom ki duniya na duniya mein luti hogi
Mohammad ke nawaase ne jo kee teghoN ke saaye mein
Bashar to kya farishtoN se na aise bandagi hogi
verses.en:
As the world of Ibn-e-Haider was plundered in Karbala
No oppressed one's world has ever been plundered like this in all the world
The worship that the grandson of Muhammad ﷺ performed beneath the shadow of swords
Neither man nor angel has ever worshipped like that

verses.ar:
Hamare khooN ke badle mein ummat bakhsh de Ya Rab
Khuda se hashr mein ye iltijaa Shabbir ki hogi
verses.en:
In exchange for our blood, O Lord, forgive the Ummah
This will be Shabbir's plea to God on the Day of Judgement
